fields: String, Bool, provider-owned named Value Objects, and optional/list/set wrappers allowed by the unchanged checked field decoder
identity: unchanged: one required String or recursively all-String Value Object; no optional/collection identity
optional: omitted top-level field and explicit null normalize to null; undefined rejects; absent differs from empty and false
list: dense inert arrays; preserve order and duplicates; empty accepted
set: dense inert arrays; reject duplicate semantic element keys; normalize by locale-independent key order; empty accepted; native JavaScript Set input rejects
immutability: copy and recursively normalize collections; freeze private-owned arrays; never freeze or sort caller arrays; Value Objects retain exact imported provider ownership
equality: complete normalized typed tuple for Value Objects, declared identity only for Entities; recursive collections use private provider keys, never ambient object methods or reference equality
hash: tagged length-prefixed equality key, not cryptographic digest; list and set and optional distinctions retained
construction: all routes normalize the whole tuple then execute every selected Rule before formation; invalid input returns structured failure and null value
validators: unchanged explicit scalar field/path bindings through required owned Value Objects; optional/collection traversal and collection-valued Rule parameters reject, never skip or infer mapping
reconstruction: same input contract as create; nested Value Objects must be owned snapshots; not a JSON codec
extension: named additive Rules; cannot change tuple or collection semantics; no inferred child extension requirements
compatibility: v1 and v2 retain separate contracts and output; no default compiler selection or profile admission
